\smallskip{\footnotesize P1: the evaluated model acts (emits tool calls), rather than only judging as a monitor; P2: unsafe outcome scored on a state change in the environment, not on text; P3: attempted action reported separately from executed action; P4: a signed or cryptographic artifact is varied as an independent variable; P5: signed-but-invalid forms (replayed, wrong binding, wrong key, out of window) are tested; P6: delivery channel of the evidence/injection analysed as a factor; P7: prompt-wording factor declared in a pre-registration; P8: a code-enforced check at the point of action is evaluated; P9: primary outcome scored deterministically, without a judge model; P10: the acting agent itself receives the varied clearance or authorization evidence.
